name: Acuven Shop
note: Default theme (Pandan) only; all 10 themes are in themes.json and acuven-shop.css.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Section bands, hero panel, order summary panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, dropdowns, dialogs.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Product and category image placeholders.

tokens.name: tile-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating image placeholder tint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface and tile.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions on surface, surface-alt, surface-raised.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers (not for control borders).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input, select, chip and stepper borders; at least 3:1 on surfaces.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected chip ring, progress done state.

tokens.name: demo
tokens.usage: DEMO badge fill. Used for demo markers only.

tokens.name: on-demo
tokens.usage: Text on demo.

tokens.name: demo-soft
tokens.usage: Background of star page hints and diamond action hints.

tokens.name: on-demo-soft
tokens.usage: Hint text on demo-soft.

tokens.name: demo-mark
tokens.usage: The star / diamond glyph; at least 3:1 on demo-soft and surfaces.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Demo banner ground (cannot be hidden by store decoration).

tokens.name: banner-2
tokens.usage: Second banner colour for striped or dotted patterns.

tokens.name: on-banner
tokens.usage: Demo banner text.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: Footer ground.

tokens.name: on-footer
tokens.usage: Footer text and links.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and text on surfaces.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success message background.

tokens.name: on-success-soft
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text under fields and error icons on surfaces.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error message background.

tokens.name: on-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on surfaces.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring outside controls; at least 3:1 on surfaces.

type.note: Display sizes are multiplied by the theme's --display-scale.
